description: Measured history for one domain per country: first and last measured dates, measured days and measurement counts, with the evidence window. Block dates, block rates and current statuses are under review because they counted CensoredPlanet rows and IODA outages as blocks; they return unknown or null, with a review object giving the newest evidence date. Pass domain=twitter.com (optional country=IR to focus one country).

country.description: Optional ISO country code to focus on, e.g. IR, RU

domain.description: Domain to trace, e.g. twitter.com, whatsapp.com

name: get_domain_timeline
